info.title: PMS Backend API
info.description:
Property Management System Backend API Documentation

**Authentication**: This API uses HTTP-only cookies for authentication. Access tokens and refresh tokens are automatically set as cookies when you login, register, or refresh tokens. Cookies are sent automatically with each request. Use the `/auth/refresh` endpoint to refresh your access token when it expires. Use the `/auth/logout` endpoint to clear authentication cookies.

**Important**: Ensure your client sends credentials (cookies) with requests by setting `withCredentials: true` (axios) or `credentials: "include"` (fetch).

---

### Error responses (BusinessException)

Most domain errors return **4xx** with body:
```json
{ "success": false, "error": { "code": "ERROR_CODE", "message": "...", "details": {} }, "timestamp": "...", "path": "..." }
```

Use `error.code` for programmatic handling; `error.message` is user-facing.
Representative billing/utility codes: `RENT_CYCLE_CLOSED`, `LEASE_NOT_ACTIVE`, `INVALID_METER_READING`, `UTILITY_NOT_ALLOWED_ON_DEPOSIT`, `PAYMENT_VOID_INVOICE`, `RENT_CYCLE_NOT_FOUND`, and payment-specific `PAYMENT_*` codes.

---

### Invoice numbers (`RentCycle.invoiceNumber`)

Structured format: **`INV-{periodSegment}-{CATEGORY}-{sequence}`** (3-digit sequence).
- Monthly: `INV-2024-01-RENT-001`, `INV-2024-01-UTILITY-001`, `INV-2024-03-DEPOSIT-001`
- Utility is billed on its **own** rent cycle (`category=UTILITY`), not as a suffix on the rent invoice.
- Legacy rows may still use older patterns until replaced.

---

### OpenAPI artifact

Generate `openapi/openapi.json` locally: `npm run openapi:export` (requires DB env like the app). Generate TypeScript types: `npm run openapi:types`.
